parameters.name: computeDevice
parameters.description: devices used by RadeonProRender for rendering (can also be set with the environment variable ANARI_RPR_COMPUTE_DEVICE)

parameters.name: gpuIndex
parameters.description: index of the GPU used for rendering

parameters.name: kernelsPath
parameters.description: directory with the precompiled Northstar kernels (default: 'hipbin' next to the device library, can also be set with the environment variable ANARI_RPR_KERNELS_PATH)

parameters.name: cachePath
parameters.description: directory for the cache files of RadeonProRender (default: 'cache' next to the device library, can also be set with the environment variable ANARI_RPR_CACHE_PATH)

parameters.name: pixelSamples
parameters.description: samples per pixel rendered by every frame

parameters.name: maxRayDepth
parameters.description: maximum number of bounces of a path

parameters.name: radianceClamp
parameters.description: clamp the radiance of indirect samples to reduce fireflies (0 disables clamping), used when clampIndirect is not set

parameters.name: maxBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of bounces of a path after the point which the camera sees (0: direct light only), takes precedence over maxRayDepth. A surface with transparency which a path passes counts as a bounce

parameters.name: maxDiffuseBounce
parameters.description: maximum number of diffuse bounces of a path (0: diffuse surfaces get direct light only), default: the limit of all bounces

parameters.name: clampIndirect
parameters.description: limit for every color channel of the light which a path collects after its first bounce (0: no limit), takes precedence over radianceClamp. Direct light is never clamped

parameters.name: visibility.camera
parameters.description: the surfaces of the instance are seen by camera rays

parameters.name: visibility.diffuse
parameters.description: the surfaces of the instance are seen by rays which were reflected diffusely (an emissive surface lights diffuse surfaces)

parameters.name: visibility.glossy
parameters.description: the surfaces of the instance are seen in specular and glossy reflections

parameters.name: visibility.transmission
parameters.description: the surfaces of the instance are seen by refracted rays

parameters.name: visibility.volumeScatter
parameters.description: the surfaces of the instance are seen by rays which were scattered by a volume (RadeonProRender has no such flag: the parameter only matters when all visibility parameters are false)

parameters.name: visibility.shadow
parameters.description: the surfaces of the instance cast shadows

objects.name: materialx
objects.description: material defined by a MaterialX document. Every image of the document is an image2D sampler parameter with the name of the file of the image (the value of the 'filename' input)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: optional object name

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: MaterialX document: the XML text when sourceType is documentInline, the path of a .mtlx file when sourceType is documentFile

parameters.name: sourceType
parameters.description: how source is interpreted

parameters.name: materialName
parameters.description: name of the surfacematerial of an inline document to use (default: the first one)
